claim_text: Creatine monohydrate is among the best-supported supplements for high-intensity performance and lean-mass support during training, with a favorable safety profile in healthy populations at studied doses.
normalized_claim: creatine monohydrate is among the best-supported supplements for high-intensity performance and lean-mass support during training, with a favorable safety profile in healthy populations at studied doses.
notes: Supports ch-23 Tier 1 creatine framing; loading optional / daily saturation consistent with Antonio 2021 misconceptions paper.

claim_text: A practical daily protein target around 1.6–2.2 g/kg body weight supports resistance-training adaptations for most healthy adults; intakes above ~1.6 g/kg show diminishing returns for FFM gains on average, while deficits may warrant higher relative intakes.
normalized_claim: a practical daily protein target around 1.6–2.2 g/kg body weight supports resistance-training adaptations for most healthy adults; intakes above ~1.6 g/kg show diminishing returns for ffm gains on average, while deficits may warrant higher relative intakes.
notes: Morton breakpoint ~1.62; ISSN 1.4–2.0 typical; Helms 2.3–3.1 g/kg FFM in lean hypocaloric athletes — manuscript higher-end deficit advice is directionally supported but Helms units are FFM not BW.

claim_text: Protein powder is a convenient way to hit total daily protein; whole-food protein can meet needs, and supplement vs food source is not the primary driver of RET-induced FFM gains when total intake is adequate.
normalized_claim: protein powder is a convenient way to hit total daily protein; whole-food protein can meet needs, and supplement vs food source is not the primary driver of ret-induced ffm gains when total intake is adequate.
notes: Optional cite for ch-23 protein powder convenience claim.

claim_text: Caffeine can meaningfully improve several aspects of exercise performance in many people at roughly 3–6 mg/kg, with individual sleep/anxiety trade-offs.
normalized_claim: caffeine can meaningfully improve several aspects of exercise performance in many people at roughly 3–6 mg/kg, with individual sleep/anxiety trade-offs.
notes: Supports Tier 1 caffeine row; manuscript should keep sleep caveat.

claim_text: Weekly hard-set volume shows a graded dose-response with hypertrophy; beginners often grow on modest volumes, while higher volumes (often discussed around ≥10 hard sets/muscle/week) tend to produce larger average gains up to recovery limits.
normalized_claim: weekly hard-set volume shows a graded dose-response with hypertrophy; beginners often grow on modest volumes, while higher volumes (often discussed around ≥10 hard sets/muscle/week) tend to produce larger average gains up to recovery limits.
notes: Manuscript correctly avoids hard numeric prescriptions for beginners; cite when hardening volume language.

claim_text: Training each major muscle group about twice per week tends to produce greater hypertrophy than once weekly when weekly volume is equated.
normalized_claim: training each major muscle group about twice per week tends to produce greater hypertrophy than once weekly when weekly volume is equated.

claim_text: Progressive increases in training stimulus (load, reps, sets, or related overload levers) are necessary for ongoing hypertrophy adaptations.
normalized_claim: progressive increases in training stimulus (load, reps, sets, or related overload levers) are necessary for ongoing hypertrophy adaptations.

claim_text: Long-term illicit AAS use is associated with adverse cardiovascular phenotypes including impaired ventricular function and greater coronary atherosclerotic burden.

claim_text: Approved GLP-1 pathway medicines can produce large, clinically meaningful weight loss under medical care (e.g., STEP 1 semaglutide 2.4 mg ~−14.9% mean at 68 weeks vs ~−2.4% placebo with lifestyle).
normalized_claim: approved glp-1 pathway medicines can produce large, clinically meaningful weight loss under medical care (e.g., step 1 semaglutide 2.4 mg ~−14.9% mean at 68 weeks vs ~−2.4% placebo with lifestyle).

claim_text: GLP-1/GIP agonist-assisted weight loss typically includes some absolute lean-mass reduction (often around ~25% of total kg lost in body-composition analyses), so resistance training and protein remain important for physique goals; lean-mass change ≠ proven sarcopenia.
normalized_claim: glp-1/gip agonist-assisted weight loss typically includes some absolute lean-mass reduction (often around ~25% of total kg lost in body-composition analyses), so resistance training and protein remain important for physique goals; lean-mass change ≠ proven sarcopenia.
notes: Supports muscle-risk themes in ch-26 without overstating sarcopenia.

claim_text: Retatrutide has Phase 2 obesity RCT evidence of substantial weight reduction and remains investigational (not FDA-approved as of late 2026 public manufacturer statements); DIY/grey-market use is unsafe and outside this book's action plans.
normalized_claim: retatrutide has phase 2 obesity rct evidence of substantial weight reduction and remains investigational (not fda-approved as of late 2026 public manufacturer statements); diy/grey-market use is unsafe and outside this book's action plans.
notes: Phase 2 = C relative to older approved agents for physique literacy; Phase 3 press exists but peer-reviewed Phase 3 papers not required for 'investigational' status claim. No titration.
